patterns.note: Sections are defined by large expanses of negative space and full-bleed background color changes, creating a very airy and luxurious feel.
A dramatic contrast between oversized, elegant serif headings and smaller, clean sans-serif body text is used throughout, emphasizing key messages.
A sophisticated, limited palette of warm off-white, deep burgundy, and black creates a sense of gravitas and luxury.
Content sections are revealed with a staggered fade-up and slide-in effect as the user scrolls, with a unique dynamic word cloud animation for the portfolio section.
The portfolio section features company names arranged in a dynamic, scattered word cloud layout that animates into place.

technique_notes: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate scroll-triggered animations, where entire content blocks or individual elements (like the word cloud companies) fade in and slide up into view as they enter the viewport.

The hero section employs a subtle parallax or reveal effect where a blurred image appears behind the main text and then transitions into a focused image as the user scrolls, eventually becoming a smaller, fixed element at the top of the screen.
Full-bleed sections with distinct background colors are used to clearly delineate different content areas, transitioning smoothly between them on scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, elegant serif headings (~4-5x body) with a classic, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
design_tokens.radius: sharp, with no visible rounded corners on any elements.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, characterized by generous negative space around all content blocks, creating a sense of openness and luxury.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its dramatic, oversized serif typography paired with a minimalist layout and sophisticated scroll-triggered reveals. The dynamic word cloud for the portfolio companies is a unique and engaging way to present information, elevating it beyond a standard list.
